title.rendered: So This Happened (EP 404) reviews: Oshiomhole, Akpabio tension sparks political debate

content.rendered:
Fresh political conversations have emerged after Senator Adams Oshiomhole alleged that Senate President Godswill Akpabio is biased against him and suspicious of his interactions with fellow lawmakers.

The claims have fueled speculation about internal tensions within the ruling APC and whether the disagreement signals deeper political battles ahead in the National Assembly.
